author: Level UP Solutions
description: Each level of a breadcrumb trail is a Ruby method that names its parent. When a view names no crumb, Crumbly works the trail out from the controller and the routes, and one test checks every trail in the app. The trail comes back as data, so your layout writes the HTML.
